Great Portland Street
190, Great Portland St
Fitzrovia, London ,
W1W 5QZ 0207 636 9016
11am - 10pm We don’t take bookings for Eat-in online.

Nearby
Getting here by public transport? Great Portland Street is well-served for bus stops. Or, if you’re getting the tube, we’re a two-minute walk from Great Portland Street station on the Circle and Hammersmith & City lines and Regent’s Park station is also close by if you’re taking the Bakerloo line.
What's around?
Looking for places to eat in Fitzrovia? Find us on Great Portland Street. If you fancy getting your steps in, Regent’s Park’s a 12-minute walk away for a dreamy PERi-PERi picnic. Or for a big day out, we’re just as close to London Zoo. The perfect pit-stop before or after your next trip.
We've got burgers, pittas, wraps, platters, salads and plant-based options as well as Nandino meals for little fans. Pick your spice from the PERi-ometer and load up on bottomless sauce and drinks. We’ve also got frozen cocktails on deck and outdoor seating if you’re feeling al fresco. Whatever your plans, we've got you.

Work at Nando’s
We’ve got a growing family of 20,000 Nandocas, fuelled by our values: Pride, Passion, Integrity, Courage and Family.
We care as much about them as we do our legendary, flame-grilled PERi-PERi - because it’s the people that make the chicken.
